title: Recycled inactive driver registration inherits stale initialized flag
summary: After indigo_add_driver(first,true), remove_driver(first), add_driver(second,false), reused slot retains initialized=true even though second INIT never ran. Custom hosts may falsely report the second initialized or reject a conflicting agent. Normal server fresh static discovery and dynamic init=true are unaffected. Next: assign scoped loader reset fix and registry-slot regression; preserve current two-agent scope.
evidence: Reproducer and exact command/result in task findings.md; indigo_libs/indigo_client.c add_driver and indigo_remove_driver at baseline e5e77e58edd20f102577a8f931651f802bdfc612.
